character.name: Ascalon
character.description:
Deals Damage to <@ba.kw>all targets</> within range
50% chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks and is less likely to be <@ba.kw>targeted</> by enemies
character.itemUsage: S.W.E.E.P. Supervisor Ascalon—the fog of the war, the smoke of the fire, the one who pounces when the time is right.
character.itemDesc: Guess how long she spends right behind you. Now guess higher.

runtimeMapping.trait: Ground all-target Physical attacks, block 0, taunt -1, independent 50% Physical/Arts evasion; install on deploy.
runtimeMapping.talent1: Native NORMAL output modifier applies one refreshed poison stack. Linear final speed scaler up to selected 3 stacks; selected 1s tick reads current source ATK and deals non-missable continuous Arts damage. Parent ownership clears on withdrawal.
runtimeMapping.talent2: Native ON_BUFF_START snapshots four-adjacent x-5 HIGH tiles and adds selected 8/10 ASPD plus 6 if at least one qualifies.
runtimeMapping.s1: AUTO charged next attack, two original .7/.967-second events, retained initial all-ground inputs, selected multiplier/storage, source maxAnimScale=1, SP locked through original 1.5-second tail. First-input loss refunds; lethal first hit does not.
runtimeMapping.s2: 35-second selected ATK buff; native ALL-motion range aura applies independent MOVE_SPEED multiplier and ground owner-killed dispatch spreads one poison stack to other legal ground targets within selected 1.3-tile circle.
runtimeMapping.s3: Original eventless .5-second Begin mapped to finite startup, then 45-second selected ATK/BAT/taunt mode and y-10 ground aura. Attacker-owned additive Physical/Arts hit-rate reduction resolves before independent recipient dodge. Only Ascalon receives selected max-HP recovery on either miss or evade; original End animation is a visual mix with no invented lock.

verificationLimits: No native particle support, module support or frame-parity claim.

Native C# FSM startup handoff, same-frame output/cancellation dispatch, animation rate/cooldown scheduling, random normal-ability RNG ordering, poison refresh tick-clock phase and expiry boundary remain bounded simulator mappings.
Poison is keyed by this source; the native independentCharacterSource=false sharing rule across duplicate Ascalon entities is not verified. Player squads/support reject duplicate operators.
S2 spread preserves selected poison stacking but its MULTIPLIER annotation versus ordinary FINAL_SCALER and native parent attachment order are not frame certified.
S3 native uninterruptible begin is represented by a fixed original-duration transition; existing control still prevents attacks. End mix changes presentation only.

usedFor: linear slow stack math, whole duration refresh and source-exit cleanup
S2 all-motion slow and ground-only death spread
